[LDEB.4.3.1] Breakpoints pause the engine when specified conditions are
met. Conditions the spec commits to supporting:

| Breakpoint kind | Fires when |
|---|---|
| On rule fire | a specific rule activates |
| On rule fire w/ predicate | a specific rule activates AND a given `where`-style predicate on its bindings matches |
| On `after` or `on response` body | that body of a specific rule fires |
| On fact assert | any fact of a schema is asserted |
| On fact assert w/ predicate | schema + slot-value match |
| On fact retract | any fact of a schema retracts, with retraction cause visible |
| On cache op | `cache-set` / `cache-get` for a specific key |

Further kinds are [LDEB.4.3.3]'s.
